label: copy phase of length-3 sequences (strongest on the final output)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or the <DEL> step). Its dominant mode is the copy phase of the shortest sequences (L=3): it is active on ~72% of those steps and they hold ~57% of activation mass. Magnitude is highest on the final step (t=5, outputting orig(2), input orig(1)); there it fires ~99% of the time and reaches near max (top examples ~0.95-1.0). It is weaker on t=4 (~0.1-0.5 of max), which accounts for most false positives. The other ~43% of mass is diffuse and low-magnitude (mostly <0.3 of max): copy steps of longer sequences, concentrated at recall_idx 2 (L=4, last step) and on the last one or two outputs (to_go<=1), with a mild preference for inputs g/h. Token identity has only weak effects. No simple predicate captures this residual.
